## Summary
Yallah Habibi is a creative web developer and prompt engineer known for distinctive neo-brutalist web experiments, humorous portfolio designs, and fast production-grade shipping through AI collaboration. Commonly recognized as the person behind that "tiny footer text" on viral web projects.

## Core Capabilities & Specializations
- **Creative Web Development:** Semantic HTML5, modern vanilla CSS, lightweight Vanilla JavaScript (zero bloat, near 100 PageSpeed scores).
- **Vibe Coding & AI Prompt Engineering:** Expert steering of state-of-the-art language models (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Cursor) to ship working, polished digital products with high speed and visual taste.
- **Neo-Brutalist UI/UX Design:** Bold colors, high-contrast layouts, retro comic sticker styling, responsive grid architectures, and micro-interactions.
- **Viral Micro-Sites & Micro-Apps:** Engaging interactive widgets, funny startup pitch evaluators, and personality-driven developer portfolios.

## Personality & Tone
Witty, sarcastic, authentic, and allergic to corporate boilerplate, endless Jira tickets, and 6-month meetings. Ships straight to production with 100% vibes.
